# Punkolink

> A cloud platform of five equal building blocks — Network, Executable, DRP, In-memory, and Database — that run on one platform and assemble into a stack. Workloads run on DRP (Docker Run Platform) and are billed by the minute in credits. Priced simply: credits at $1 each, 20 free to start, no card.

## The cloud

- [Cloud](https://punkolink.com/cloud.html): The five building blocks in detail — Network (the Punkolink L7 router: routing, load balancing, layer-3 and layer-7 access control, rate limiting, bot and brute-force protection, availability monitoring, web GUI), Executable (upload a compiled binary or a Node.js project; it is stored inert and nothing is billed until you start it), DRP (where an Executable runs — on start, DRP wraps it in a container with the right environment and brings it up; it also places workloads across the cloud's machines and can bring up isolated Linux environments), In-memory (managed Valkey, an open-source in-memory data store, for caching, session state, job queues, and rate-limit counters), and Database (one managed Postgres instance with three extensions on it — Apache AGE for graph, ParadeDB for search and analytics, pgvector for vectors — not four separate services).

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://punkolink.com/pricing.html): One thing to buy — credits, priced at $1 each, sold in packs of 5. 20 free credits on signup, no card. Credits are spent by the minute as blocks run; a DRP instance costs about 5 credits per month.
- [Pricing Policy](https://punkolink.com/legal/pricing-policy.html): The exact terms — a credit is a unit of account and prepayment for services, not a payment instrument, not e-money, not withdrawable. Per-minute rates, including the exact DRP rate, are set out here.
